scope.profile: declarative repair profile with two seeded modules and two owned source files
scope.provider: strict captured test harness invoked by the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The equality case sets maximumContextModules=2, maximumContextFiles=2, and maximumContextBytes=77 for two required modules/files totaling exactly 77 UTF-8 source bytes. It verifies the active loop reaches the harness once with both exact file bodies, then records NO_CHANGES with accepted source/head preserved and no pending attempt. The paired refusal case retains the existing one-under/over controls for the individual dimensions.
